name: Replicated Stochastic-Measure Gradient
lineage_evidence: SAMPLING_VARIANCE_ATLAS:DT latent/time/bridge variance dominated 7/7 active rows
SAMPLING_VARIANCE_ATLAS:HJ independent-batch and latent/time/bridge variance dominated 22/22 rows each
SEARCH-001:AEB averaged z and -z endpoints before nonlinear losses and changed the endpoint law
SEARCH-001:PTQ changed the bridge-time sampling measure
SEARCH-005:G1-HJ-ACMP antithetically averaged only the biased HJ auxiliary correction and then projected it

prior_equivalence_audit.material_difference: RSMG does not average endpoints, alter the time/domain measure, add an auxiliary correction or concatenate images into a larger PatchNCE minibatch. It evaluates two conditionally independent complete native UNSB stochastic views on the same batch-1 unpaired tensors and averages their per-player gradients before the native optimizer step. Each view keeps batch-1 PatchNCE negatives. Inference and every single-view endpoint law are exactly plain UNSB.

unsb_object: the stochastic gradient estimator of the native coupled D, E, G and F UNSB game conditional on one official batch-1 unpaired sample
formula: Let S_k be the complete current state and b_k the one official batch-1 unpaired A/B sampler draw. For each native player p in the registered order D, E, then joint (G,F), draw xi_1,xi_2 independently from the exact native conditional latent, bridge-noise, uniform bridge-time and PatchNCE patch measure, evaluate g_p^(r)=grad_{theta_p} L_p(S_k,b_k,xi_r) at the same pre-step player parameters, and commit gbar_p=(g_p^(1)+g_p^(2))/2 through the unchanged Adam optimizer. Earlier players are committed before constructing the conditional state for the next player exactly as in native UNSB. The two views are never concatenated, so PatchNCE remains batch1.
identity_or_unbiased_condition: For every player and fixed current state/batch, E[gbar_p | S_k,b_k]=E[g_p | S_k,b_k] and Var(gbar_p | S_k,b_k)=Var(g_p | S_k,b_k)/2 because the two stochastic views are conditionally iid. Setting stochastic_replicates=1 dispatches the original optimize_parameters path byte-for-byte. The objective, data measure, endpoint law and native stationary points in expectation are unchanged.
target_inaccessibility_proof: Both replicas receive the same official unpaired batch-1 tensors and draw only native training randomness. No held-out image, paired mapping, quality metric, domain label controller or confirmation sample is addressable. Replica averaging is fixed at derivation time and never depends on a measured result.

expected_applicable_state.condition: native or auxiliary evidence indicates that latent/time/bridge stochasticity is a dominant component of update variation
expected_applicable_state.self_null_state: not required because the construction is an unbiased estimator; exact plain identity is available at one replica
expected_applicable_state.compute_only_risk: any gain must be reported as compute-sensitive because the method uses two stochastic loss evaluations per optimizer update

falsifying_experiment: Kill if a fixed-state Monte Carlo gate rejects equality of the replicated and native gradient means, if the observed gradient variance is not lower, if either replica creates cross-image PatchNCE negatives, or if zero-replica/one-replica identity and full-state resume are not exact. A negative e200 result closes only this two-replica native estimator.
compute_cost: approximately two complete native stochastic loss/gradient evaluations per optimizer update; optimizer step count and data exposure remain unchanged
memory_cost: one additional gradient accumulator; the two stochastic graphs may be executed serially so peak activation memory remains close to native
recovery_state_cost: replica count, operator update index and the ordinary Python/NumPy/CPU/CUDA RNG states; no model copy

ablation_definitions.proposal_only: Average two independent native stochastic gradients for G and F only while D and E retain one native view; this isolates generator-side stochastic-field variance.
ablation_definitions.observable_only: Evaluate the second stochastic view and record per-player variance/cosine, but discard it and commit the exact first-view native update.
ablation_definitions.projected_or_full: Average both independent views for D, E, G and F in native player order; no projection, auxiliary loss or endpoint averaging is applied.

unbiased_proof: Conditional on the current full state and the one official unpaired batch, the two replica randomness bundles are iid under the unchanged native UNSB measure. Linearity of expectation gives E[(g1+g2)/2]=E[g], and conditional independence gives Var((g1+g2)/2)=Var(g)/2. The Adam transform is applied once after averaging, exactly where the native stochastic gradient estimator enters the optimizer.
